When Donald Trump called FIFA President Gianni Infantino to personally lobby for the reversal of a USA red card, he may have ushered in the next stage in hard power's invasion of the pitch detailed in my @ForeignPolicy story, "Is Sports Diplomacy Still Possible?" I'm simultaneously proud that my essay ran as part of FP's July Fourth weekend coverage—and a teensy bit regretful that now the essay can't include the Trump/red card flap. First, about that red card—and I'm really trying to be a dispassionate journalist here rather than an avid soccer fan—but I think millions of viewers saw it as a bad call. You might say, what else is new? Fans usually take a red card badly; but it's hard to see how the VAR review could interpret that personal collision as a deliberate foul. On the other hand, I also saw the red card against England in last night's game against Mexico as a travesty. Should King Charles call Infantino? I haven't personally watched all of the 13 red card plays in this tournament; once in a while, I do have to peel my eyes away from the screen during the World Cup. But it wouldn't surprise me if the other red cards have their doubters, too. I'm going out on a limb here, but how about an automatic Article 27 red card review during the World Cup, especially, though not necessarily only, if a team is continuing on without a player lost to a red card? What do you say FIFA? Beyond automating the review process, I don't see how you can minimize the accusations of politicization. Though it's fair to say they would persist on some level as the review outcomes are bound to differ. It's a bizarre sports story on so many levels. Trump—who has been AWOL from the FIFA World Cup, including Team USA games—is reportedly planning to attend the World Cup final and award the trophy. He stood there this morning at an unrelated press conference in the Oval Office and proclaimed his ignorance of soccer, saying that until this instance, he hadn't known "what the hell a red card was." Almost immediately, video surfaced of Infantino showing him yellow and red cards from behind the Oval Office desk at an earlier media op. Those two things aren't necessarily mutually exclusive. And that's putting aside the oddest detail of all—the player who received the red card, Folarin Balogun, can only compete for Team USA as a beneficiary of the birthright citizenship that Trump wants to overturn. Finally, let's consider how this phone call could be precedent setting. Belgium tried to appeal the successful appeal by the USA. When Belgium's appeal was denied today, Infantino rushed out a statement to say, in a nutshell, yes, he had received a call from the American president—he gets a lot of phone calls—but this decision was arrived at by an independent disciplinary committee, so there! Pullquote: "Respect for independent institutions and the rule of law is what protects the integrity of our competitions and the credibility of FIFA at all times.” But even if the red card was unwarranted, if Team "Why Not Us?" brings it home, fans will forever wonder if this call (in both senses of the word) made the difference. foreignpolicy.com/2026/07/02…

بھی متعارف کروائی جا رہی ہے جسکے تحت حج کے خواہاں لوگ مستقبل میں حج کیلئے سیونگ اسیکم سے مستفید ہو سکیں گے. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ حج کے تمام تر نظام کو ڈیجیٹل کیا جا رہا ہے جس میں ادائیگیاں بھی ڈیجیٹل نظام سے ہونگیں. اسکے علاوہ شکایات کا ڈیجیٹل نظام اور ڈیجیٹل نگرانی ہوگی. پالیسی کے تحت سرکاری اور پرائیوٹ حج کا کوٹہ مختص کیا گیا ہے. پالیسی کے تحت لانگ اور شارٹ حج پروگرام متعارف کروائے جار ہے ہیں جبکہ حجاج کرام کی ضروری تربیت اور تکافل و ہنگامی ریسپانس بھی پالیسی کا حصہ ہیں. کابینہ نے ہدایت کی کہ معاونین حج کی تقرری ایک شفاف نظام اور خالصتاً میرٹ پر جائے، مزید برآں پرائیوٹ و سرکاری حج کی تھرڈ پارٹی ویلیڈیشن یقینی بنائی جائے. وفاقی کابینہ نے شہریوں کو علاج معالجے کی معیاری سہولیات کو یقینی بنانے کیلئے اسلام آباد میں موجود آئیسولیشن ہاسپٹل اینڈ انفیکشئس ٹریٹمنٹ سینٹر (IHITC) اور ریجنل بلڈ سینٹر (RBC) کی سروسز کی آؤٹ سورسنگ کی پالیسی منظوری دے دی. فیصلے کے بعد وزارت قومی صحت ان اسپتالوں کی آؤٹ سورسنگ قوائد و ضوابط کے مطابق یقینی بنائے گی. وفاقی کابینہ کو وزیرِ ریلوے کی جانب سے پاکستان ریلوے کی کارکردگی پر بھی بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو وزیر ریلوے نے بتایا کہ ریلوے کی آمدن 2024-25 میں 95 ارب بڑھ کر گزشتہ مالی سال 2025-2026 میں 115 ارب روپے کو عبور کر گئی جو کہ 24.19 فیصد اضافہ ہے۔ فریٹ آمدن میں 8 ارب سے زائد، دیگر آمدن میں 7 ارب سے زائد، پراپرٹی و لینڈ آمدن میں 6 ارب سے زائد اور مسافروں کی آمدو رفت سے آمدن میں 3.37 فیصد کا اضافہ ہوا. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ ریلوے آپریشنز میں بہتری کے ساتھ ساتھ فریٹ کارگو کی آمد و رفت کی بہتری یقینی بنائی گئی ہے. وفاقی کابینہ نے وزیرِ ریلوے حنیف عباسی اور انکی ٹیم کی تعریف کی. وفاقی کابینہ نے کابینہ کمیٹی برائے قانون سازی (CCLC) کے 19 مئی 2026 اور اقتصادی رابطہ کمیٹی (ECC) کے 2 جولائی 2026 کو منعقدہ اجلاسوں میں لئے گئے فیصلوں کی توثیق کر دی. Dr. R. Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog, addressed the National Workshop on Strengthening Tribal Research Institutes, organised by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs in Bhubaneswar. The workshop focused on strengthening research, technology, governance, institutional capacity and partnerships to build Tribal Research Institutes into stronger knowledge and policy institutions. Dr. Balasubramaniam called for Tribal Research Institutes to broaden their research agenda to better understand the social, political, economic and cultural transitions shaping tribal communities. He emphasised that research must move beyond data to listening by respecting tribal belief systems, lived experiences and traditional wisdom, and that TRIs should serve as anthropological knowledge repositories, policy think tanks and advocates for tribal voices, while humanising data through ground truthing and community perspectives. Recognising indigenous knowledge as a national resource, he called for its documentation, preservation and recognition, and methodologies to account for its contribution to India’s Gross Domestic Knowledge Product. As AI reshapes the future, preserving indigenous knowledge and strengthening tribal-led research become even more critical. The workshop also launched TribeX, a digital learning platform for tribal arts, culture, languages, traditional knowledge and skill development. #TribalDevelopment #IndigenousKnowledge @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp @drrbalu

🚨🇫🇷🇩🇪 DÉFENSE EUROPÉENNE : LA FRANCE ÉCARTÉE D’EURODRONE Nouvel épisode des tensions franco-allemandes dans l’industrie de défense européenne. Selon plusieurs sources du secteur, Dassault Aviation aurait été écarté du programme Eurodrone, piloté par Airbus Defence & Space. Une décision qui relance une question fondamentale : L’Europe de la défense est-elle un projet de coopération… ou un instrument au service des intérêts nationaux les plus puissants ? ➡️ Pourquoi le principe du « meilleur industriel » est-il invoqué lorsqu’il sert certains acteurs, mais contesté lorsqu’il bénéficie à la France ? ➡️ Comment construire une autonomie stratégique européenne lorsque les grands programmes sont constamment paralysés par des rivalités nationales ? ➡️ La France finance-t-elle une Europe de la défense dont elle est progressivement exclue ? Le dossier Eurodrone illustre une réalité souvent passée sous silence. Derrière les discours sur la souveraineté européenne, les États continuent de défendre avant tout leurs propres intérêts industriels et technologiques. À force de blocages, de rivalités et de doubles standards, l’Europe risque de compromettre sa capacité à bâtir une véritable industrie de défense capable de rivaliser avec les États-Unis, la Chine ou la Russie. L’Europe de la défense ne pourra exister que si les règles sont les mêmes pour tous. Aujourd’hui, beaucoup commencent à en douter. Senior Officials of ASEAN and the Republic of Korea (ROK) reaffirmed their commitment to further advancing the ASEAN-ROK Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP) at the 30th ASEAN-ROK Dialogue, held in Seoul today. The Meeting reviewed progress in the implementation of the ASEAN-ROK Plan of Action (2026–2030) across the political-security, economic, socio-cultural, and cross-pillar sectors, and exchanged views on priorities to further strengthen cooperation under the CSP. The ROK reaffirmed its strong support for ASEAN Centrality and its commitment to advancing the CSP in alignment with ASEAN 2045: Our Shared Future, as reflected in the CSP Vision introduced by President Lee Jae Myung at the 26th ASEAN-ROK Summit in 2025. Both sides underscored the importance of enhancing cooperation in addressing traditional and non-traditional security challenges, particularly online scams; promoting maritime cooperation; deepening trade and investment, including through the upgrading of the ASEAN-Korea Free Trade Area (AKFTA); advancing digital transformation, including in support of the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA); promoting emerging technologies, including AI; strengthening food and energy security; and supporting MSMEs and startups. The Meeting also encouraged further cooperation in culture and creative industries, people-to-people exchanges, health, environment, climate change, and energy transition, including support for the ASEAN Power Grid (APG). The Meeting noted the ROK’s proposals on the ASEAN-ROK AI Companionship Initiative, the ASEAN-ROK Cultural and Creative Industries Initiative, and the Shared Roots: ASEAN-ROK Creative Heritage Initiative. Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening cooperation in connectivity, smart cities, sustainable development, sub-regional development, and narrowing the development gap, including through support for the Initiative for ASEAN Integration (IAI). The ROK also reaffirmed commitment to advancing practical cooperation under the ASEAN Outlook on the Indo-Pacific (AOIP). Both sides exchanged views on regional and international developments of mutual interest and concern, reaffirming the importance of promoting dialogue and cooperation in addressing regional and global challenges. The 30th ASEAN-ROK Dialogue was co-chaired by the Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and SOM Leader of Thailand, Eksiri Pintaruchi, and Deputy Minister for Political Affairs and SOM Leader of the ROK, Eui-hae Cecilia Chung, and attended by Senior Officials or their representatives of ASEAN Member States, the Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for ASEAN Political-Security Community and their respective delegations. Photo credit: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Korea

A delegation of Polio Oversight Board calls on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. Islamabad, 7 July 2026.

اسلام آباد: 7 جولائی 2026. وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف سے پولیو نگرانی بورڈ (Polio Oversight Board) کے 7 رکنی وفد کی آج اسلام آباد میں ملاقات ہوئی. وفد میں روٹری کے پولیو اوورسائیٹ بورڈ کے چیئر مائیک میکگورن (Mike McGovern)، گیٹس فاؤنڈیشن کے گلوبل ڈیویلپمنٹ کے صدر کرس ایلائیس (Chris Elias)،ریجنل ڈائیریکٹر WHO EMRO ڈاکٹر حنان بلخی (Dr. Hanan Balkhy)، یونیسیف (UNICEF)، گاوی (GAVI) اور پاکستان میں انسداد پولیو کیلئے تعاون کے دیگر شراکت داروں کے نمائندگان شریک تھے. وزیرِ اعظم نے وفد کا خیر مقدم کیا اور انسداد پولیو کیلئے تمام شراکت داروں کا حکومت پاکستان کے ساتھ تعاون پر شکریہ ادا کیا. وفد سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ پاکستان کے بچوں کے مستقبل کو پولیو جیسے موذی مرض سے بچانے کیلئے ہر ممکن اقدام کر رہے ہیں. وزیراعظم نے اجلاس میں پولیو سے پاک پاکستان کے عزم کی بھی تجدید کی. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ پولیو کا خاتمہ اہم قومی ترجیح ہے اور تمام اسٹیک ہولڈرز مشترکہ کوششیں مزید تیز کریں. وزیراعظم نے جنوبی خیبر پختونخوا کے پولیو ہاٹ اسپاٹس پر خصوصی توجہ اور مؤثر حکمتِ عملی اپنانے کی ہدایت کی. انہوں نے کہا کہ روٹری انٹرنیشنل، گیٹس فاؤنڈیشن، ڈبلیو ایچ او، یونیسیف، کنگ سلمان ریلیف، سینٹر فار ڈیزیز کنٹرول اینڈ پریوینشن USA اور تمام شراکت داروں کے انسداد پولیو کے حوالے سے اقدامات پر تہہ دل سے شکر گزار ہیں. وزیرِ صحت، وزیرِ مملکت برائے صحت، فوکل پرسن انسدادِ پولیو، نیشنل کوارڈینیٹر انسداد پولیو اور حکومتی ٹیم کے تمام ارکان انسداد پولیو کیلئے اقدامات پر لائق تحسین ہیں. وفد نے پولیو فری پاکستان کے لیے حکومت کے مؤثر اقدامات کو سراہتے ہوئے نمایاں پیش رفت پر وزیراعظم کو خراج تحسین پیش کیا. ملاقات میں وفاقی وزیرِ قومی صحت سید مصطفی کمال، وزیرِ اعظم کی فوکل پرسن برائے انسداد پولیو سینیٹر عائشہ رضا فاروق اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے بھی شرکت کی. The Highest Expression of Moral Excellence: Attaining the Pleasure of Allah Almighty The ultimate objective of an individual's life is moral excellence. True moral excellence is embodied in complete servitude to Allah Almighty, and its highest expression is attaining His pleasure (Riḍā' al-Ilāhī). Accordingly, the actual purpose of human life is to seek the pleasure of Allah Almighty. In other words, on an individual level, the purpose of life is to become insān-e-murtaḍā—a person with whom his Lord is pleased.

সংবাদ বিজ্ঞপ্তি মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী কর্তৃক সেনাবাহিনীর গ্রীষ্মকালীন প্রশিক্ষণ ২০২৬ পরিদর্শন ঢাকা, ০৭ জুলাই ২০২৬ (মঙ্গলবার): আজ গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী জনাব তারেক রহমান, এমপি, সেনাবাহিনীর ৯ পদাতিক ডিভিশন ও সাভার এরিয়ার দায়িত্বপূর্ণ এলাকা মানিকগঞ্জের সিংগাইর এ গ্রীষ্মকালীন প্রশিক্ষণ ২০২৬ এর কার্যক্রম পরিদর্শন করেন। মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী প্রশিক্ষণ এলাকায় পৌঁছালে তাঁকে সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান জেনারেল ওয়াকার-উজ-জামান, এসবিপি, ওএসপি, এসজিপি, পিএসসি এবং জিওসি, ৯ পদাতিক ডিভিশন ও এরিয়া কমান্ডার, সাভার এরিয়া মেজর জেনারেল এস এম আসাদুল হক, এনডিসি, পিএসসি অভ্যর্থনা জানান। পরিদর্শনকালে, মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী যুদ্ধক্ষেত্রে সেনাসদস্যদের অবস্থান, রণকৌশলের প্রয়োগ, সমরাস্ত্রের ব্যবহার এবং বিভিন্ন বাস্তবধর্মী প্রশিক্ষণ কার্যক্রম পরিদর্শন করেন। এ সময় তিনি সেনাসদস্যদের সঙ্গে কুশলাদি বিনিময় করেন এবং চলমান প্রশিক্ষণের মান, পেশাদারিত্ব ও অপারেশনাল প্রস্তুতিতে সন্তোষ প্রকাশ করেন। সেনাসদস্যদের উদ্দেশ্যে দিকনির্দেশনামূলক বক্তব্যে মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর প্রতি দেশের জনগণের গভীর আস্থার কথা উল্লেখ করেন। তিনি পেশাদার প্রশিক্ষণ, শৃঙ্খলা ও সর্বোচ্চ প্রস্তুতি বজায় রাখার উপর গুরুত্বারোপ করেন এবং বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর উত্তরোত্তর সাফল্য কামনা করেন। এ সময় মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রীর প্রতিরক্ষা উপদেষ্টা ব্রিগেডিয়ার জেনারেল ড. এ কে এম শামছুল ইসলাম, পিএসসি, জি (অবঃ); ঊর্ধ্বতন সামরিক ও বেসামরিক কর্মকর্তাগণ এবং বিভিন্ন পর্যায়ের সেনাসদস্যগণ উপস্থিত ছিলেন।

दिल्ली के लिए आज का दिन एक नए हरित संकल्प का दिन है। आदरणीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी के ‘एक पेड़ माँ के नाम’ अभियान को नई गति देते हुए, माननीय केंद्रीय गृह एवं सहकारिता मंत्री श्री @AmitShah जी ने सेंट्रल रिज और नानकपुरा रिज में पौधारोपण कर दिल्ली के 70 लाख पौधारोपण अभियान का शुभारंभ किया। दिल्ली के प्रति माननीय गृह मंत्री जी का स्नेह, मार्गदर्शन और सतत सहयोग हर महत्वपूर्ण जनकल्याणकारी पहल में हमारे लिए प्रेरणा और संबल रहा है। यह अभियान आने वाली पीढ़ियों को स्वच्छ हवा, हरियाली और स्वस्थ जीवन देने का संकल्प है। हमने इस अभियान से जुड़ना आपके लिए बेहद सरल बना दिया है। अब आप ऑनलाइन अपना स्लॉट बुक कर आसानी से पौधारोपण कर सकते हैं और 70 लाख पौधे लगाने के इस अभियान से जुड़ सकते हैं। आइए, ‘एक पेड़ माँ के नाम’ लगाकर इस जनआंदोलन को जन-जन तक पहुंचाएं और मिलकर हरित, स्वच्छ और विकसित दिल्ली का निर्माण करें। इस अवसर पर केंद्रीय पर्यावरण, वन एवं जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्री श्री भूपेंद्र यादव जी, दिल्ली भाजपा प्रदेश अध्यक्ष एवं केंद्रीय राज्य मंत्री श्री हर्ष मल्होत्रा जी सहित कैबिनेट के मंत्रीगण और जनप्रतिनिधि उपस्थित रहे। @byadavbjp @hdmalhotra #GreenDelhi #EkPedMaaKeNaam

The stage is set in Ankara. Under President Erdoğan’s leadership, Türkiye stands ready to welcome NATO members at a moment that will define the Alliance’s future. The decisions taken in Ankara will not merely address immediate challenges — they will shape the Euro‑Atlantic security environment for the years ahead. Collective defense remains the core of NATO, yet the strategic environment is shifting. Threats are multi‑domain, faster, and more complex. Traditional metrics no longer capture this reality. What matters now is output: deployable capability, industrial capacity, and operational readiness. A stronger European contribution is essential — but restrictions on defense‑industrial cooperation undermine efficiency and slow response. These constraints have become strategic liabilities. European defense initiatives must remain fully inclusive of all NATO Allies. The real issue is not only how we respond, but how we organize cooperation in a way that reflects today’s realities. The Ankara Summit will guide the Alliance in aligning its structures with the world it faces. Türkiye’s objective is clear: a more coherent, more capable, and more resilient Alliance.

اسلام آباد: 7 جولائی 2026. وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے سمیڈا (SMEDA) پر جائزہ اجلاس میں ملکی برآمدات میں اضافے کیلئے چھوٹے اور درمیانے درجے کی صنعتوں (SMEs) کو قرضوں کی فراہمی میں سہولیات فراہم کرنے کی ہدایت کی. اجلاس میں مزید ہدایات دیتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ چھوٹے اور درمیانے درجے کی صنعتوں کی استعداد کار بڑھانے بالخصوص کسانوں کی اجناس و پھلوں کی پراسیسنگ کیلئے انہیں آگاہی اور قرضے فراہم کرنے کے حوالے سے سہولت دی جائے. کمرشل بینکوں کی چھوٹے و درمیانے درجے کی صنعتوں کو قرضوں کی فراہمی کے حوالے سے خصوصی پراڈکٹس کی تیاری کی حوصلہ افزائی کی جائے. چھوٹے و درمیانے درجے کی صنعتوں کو فیزیبیلٹی کی تیاری اور دیگر مراحل میں مدد فراہم کی جائے. وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ ایس ایم ایز کی ترقی کی راہ میں حائل رکاوٹوں کو دور کرنے کیلئے ہنگامی بنیادوں پر اقدامات ضروری ہیں. سمیڈا نوجوان بشمول خواتین آنٹرپرنیورز کو چھوٹے و درمیانے درجے کی صنعتیں لگانے میں معاونت فراہم کرے. اجلاس کو سمیڈا کی جانب سے ایس ایم ایز کی سہولت کیلئے مختلف اقدامات پر بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ پاکستانی ایس ایم ایز کی عالمی منڈی تک رسائی اور برآمدات بڑھانے کیلئے رواں برس 700 ایس ایم ایز کی 16 ایونٹس میں شرکت یقینی بنائی گئی. اسکے ساتھ ساتھ 35 شہروں میں ایس ایم ایز کو مالی ضابطوں اور کاروبار کے حوالے سے ٹریننگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو سمیڈا کے تحت مختلف اقدامات پر بھی روشنی ڈالی گئی. وزیرِ اعظم نے ایس ایم ایز کی قرضوں تک رسائی کیلئے اسٹیٹ بینک اور کمرشل بینکوں کے ساتھ مل کر ایک جامع لائحہ عمل مرتب کرنے کی ہدایت کی. اجلاس میں نائب وزیرِ اعظم و وزیرِ خارجہ سینیٹر محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزیر ڈاکٹر مصدق ملک، معاون خصوصی ہارون اختر اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی. چاروں صوبوں کے چیف سیکریٹریز اور شعبے کے ماہرین نے بھی ویڈیو لنک کے ذریعے اجلاس میں شرکت کی. کالم نویس اپنے کالموں میں استعمال کرتے ہیں .... وہ آئے بزم میں اتنا تو میر نے دیکھا پھر اُس کے بعد چراغوں میں روشنی نہ رہی یہ شعر آغا شاعر قزلباش کے ایک شاگرد مہاراج بہادر برق کا ہے اور غلط طور پر میر تقی میر سے منسوب ہے۔ آپ میر کے چھ دیوان پڑھ لیں کہیں بھی آپ کو یہ شعر نظر نہیں آئے گا۔ دہلی میں 1884ءمیں پیدا ہونے والے مہاراج بہادر برق کے مذکورہ بالا شعر کا پہلا مصرع اچھی یاد کر لیں ع وہ آئے بزم ظفر سے منسوب کر رکھا ہے عمر دراز مانگ کے لائے تھے چار دن دو آرزو میں کٹ گئے، دو انتظار میں یہ شعر بہادر شاہ ظفر کا بالکل نہیں بلکہ سیماب اکبر آبادی کا ہے۔ ان کی 1947ءمیں شائع ہونے والی کتاب ”کلیم عجم“ میرے پاس بھی موجود ہے۔ جس شخص کو شبہ ہو اسے سیماب اکبر آبادی کی پوری غزل کی فوٹو کاپی مہیا کی جا سکتی ہے۔ سیماب نے زیر بحث شعر کا پہلا مصرع اس طرح کہا تھا ع عمر دراز، مانگ کے لائی تھی چار دن بڑے پڑھے لکھے اور اعلیٰ ادبی ذوق رکھنے والے حضرات بھی درج ذیل شعر کو کبھی علامہ اقبال اور کبھی حالی سے منسوب کر دیتے ہیں خدا نے آج تک اس قوم کی حالت نہیں بدلی نہ ہو جس کو خیال آپ اپنی حالت کے بدلنے کا یہ شعر قرآن حکیم کی آیت کا ترجمہ ہے اور یہ منظوم تخلیقی ترجمہ مولانا ظفر علی خان نے کیا ہے۔ یہ شعر 1937ءمیں شائع ہونے والی مولانا ظفر علی خان کی کتاب ”بہارستان“ میں شامل ہے۔ ایک اور شعر جو کبھی میر تقی میر اور کبھی امیر مینائی سے منسوب کر دیا جاتا ہے وہ یہ ہے شکست و فتح نصیبوں سے ہے ولے اے میر مقابلہ تو دلِ ناتواں نے خوب کیا یہ شعر نہ تو میر تقی میر کا ہے اور نہ ہی امیر مینائی کا ہے بلکہ یہ شعر محمد یار خاں امیر کا ہے اور شعر کا درست متن بھی یوں ہے شکست و فتح میاں اتفاق ہے لیکن مقابلہ تو دلِ ناتواں نے خوب کیا مصحفی کا یہ شعر ضرب المثل کی طرح مشہور ہے مَیں عجب یہ رسم دیکھی، مجھے روزِ عیدِ قرباں وہی ذبح بھی کرے ہے، وہی لے ثواب اُلٹا یہی شعر پہلے مصرعے کی تبدیلی کے ساتھ اِنشا سے بھی منسوب ہے یہ عجیب ماجرا ہے کہ بروزِ عیدِ قرباں وہی ذبح بھی کرے ہے وہی لے ثواب الُٹا قاضی عبدالودود نے تحقیق کے بعد ثابت کیا ہے کہ یہ شعر مصحفی ہی کا ہے۔ کالم کا دامن چونکہ مختصر ہوتا ہے اس لئے مَیں تفصیلات میں جائے بغیر چند اشعار کا درست متن اور اُنکے خالق اصل شاعروں کے نام درج کر رہا ہوں : اس دین کی فطرت میں قدرت نے لچک دی ہے اُتنا ہی یہ اُبھرے گا جتنا کہ دبا دیں گے (صفی لکھنوی) اس کو ناقدری عالم کا صلہ کہتے ہیں مر چکے ہم تو زمانے نے بہت یاد کیا (برج نرائن چکبست) افسوس بے شمار سخن ہائے گفتنی خوف فساد خلق سے منابع خبری از وقوع انفجار در دمشق، پایتخت سوریه، خبر دادند. خبرگزاری فرانسه نوشته است که امروز (سه‌شنبه، ۱۶ سرطان) هم‌زمان با بازدید امانوئل مکرون، رییس‌جمهور فرانسه از پایتخت سوریه، صدای انفجاری در مرکز دمشق شنیده شد. خبرگزاری رویترز به نقل از یک مقام امنیتی نوشته است که مجموعه‌ای از بمب‌های انفجاری در نزدیکی هتلی که رییس‌جمهور فرانسه در دمشق اقامت دارد، منفجر شده است. به نقل از این منبع، پس از انفجار، جاده‌ها مسدود و اقدامات امنیتی اجرا شد. به گزارش رویترز، از محل انفجار دودی به هوا برخاسته است. مکرون نخستین رهبر مهم اتحادیه اروپا است که از زمان سرنگونی بشار اسد، رییس‌جمهور سوریه، از دمشق بازدید می‌کند.

🛢 US crude stocks in the Strategic Petroleum Reserve fell by another 6.2 million barrels in the week ending July 3, dropping to 319.5 million barrels, the lowest level since April 1983, according to Department of Energy data reported by Reuters. The reserve has been drained steadily since Trump ordered the release of 172 million barrels in March to plug gaps in global supply and hold down fuel prices after launching war on Iran with Israel. Since the war began at the end of February, total US inventories, commercial and strategic combined, have fallen by nearly 121 million barrels to 734 million. Once the full 172-million-barrel release completes, the SPR is set to fall to roughly 243 million barrels, its lowest since 1982. That is near the reserve’s estimated operational floor of between 150 million barrels, below which the underground salt caverns that store the oil risk losing the pressure needed to maintain their structural integrity, per industry analysts. Tuesday marks the 89th anniversary of the historic July 7 Incident, or Lugou Bridge Incident. On July 7, 1937, Japanese troops attacked the Chinese garrison at Lugou Bridge, also known as Marco Polo Bridge, outside Wanping Town in what is now Fengtai District of Beijing. The bullet scars on the wall remain visible today, like wounds that never healed. While Japan's aggression against China had begun as early as 1931, the July 7 Incident marked its escalation into a full-scale invasion and the start of China's nationwide resistance. China suffered more than 35 million military and civilian casualties with countless families torn apart during the war.

At least nine police officers were killed in a militant attack on a police checkpoint in Pakistan's southwestern Balochistan province, officials said on Tuesday. According to the deputy commissioner of Ziarat district, militants attacked a police checkpoint in the Kuch Mangi Phase III area, killing nine police personnel. The bodies of the slain officers were shifted to the District Headquarters Hospital in Ziarat. Ziarat District Police Officer Abdul Qudoos said two station house officers were among those killed in the attack. Police said an exchange of fire between militants and security personnel had continued since Monday night. Following the attack, additional police and security forces were deployed to the area. Authorities have launched a search and clearance operation to track down the attackers. #SamaaTV

Worth a read. 👇 DroneBomber (@DrnBmbr) ❗️Drone Route to the Omsk Oil Refinery After analyzing Russian monitoring channels and local chat groups, we reconstructed the following route. Kazan was the last point where the Russians still had any meaningful air defense coverage and radar tracking. Once the drones passed that area, all information about them disappeared. Russian monitoring channels simply "lost" the drones and from that point onward issued only yellow alerts (potential UAV threat without confirmed tracking). This says a great deal about the actual state of Russian air defenses along the rest of the route. The drones covered approximately 2,800–3,000 km, depending on the estimate. The strike involved upgraded FP-1 attack drones equipped with redesigned wings that were longer and featured a modified aerodynamic profile. According to eyewitness reports and available footage, there were seven impacts at the Omsk Oil Refinery, including hits on two distillation columns. Russian forces reportedly deployed an A-50 AEW&C aircraft to provide radar support and a Su-57 fighter in an attempt to intercept the drones. Based on currently available information, only one out of eight drones was shot down. There was no meaningful air defense around the target. No surface-to-air missile launches or air defense systems were observed in operation—only small-arms fire. The drones approached the facility with little interference, arriving one after another. Even the protective netting that Russian forces had installed around parts of the refinery proved ineffective. They were well aware that this facility was a potential target. It was the only major refinery that had not yet been struck and one of Russia's key fuel production sites, supplying many regions across the country. Either they did not believe Ukrainian drones were capable of flying more than 2,500 km, or they placed too much confidence in those protective nets. I won't go into detail about the route itself. I'll simply say that it reflects a well-planned and carefully executed long-range strike operation. I have not yet seen any detailed Russian analysis of the mission, and there is no reason to reveal our own. Excellent work. ⚡️ — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/DrnBmbr/status/2074188475838898211#m

India is the world's largest producer and exporter of rice, yet the Food Corporation of India (FCI) is holding rice stocks that are nearly five times the prescribed buffer norm, at a carrying cost of over Rs. 10,712 crores in FY25. In their latest article, Ashok Gulati, Ritika Juneja, and Purvi Thangaraj trace this surplus to three interlinked policy distortions: open-ended MSP procurement, with several states offering bonuses above the MSP; free electricity and heavily subsidised urea. Instead of addressing these underlying distortions, the government's response has been to divert surplus rice to ethanol production, supplying rice to distilleries at Rs. 23/kg despite FCI's economic cost of about Rs. 44/kg on the justification that it is broken and damaged rice. The authors also highlight the environmental costs of the current policy framework, including the use of ~ 4,000 litres of water to produce one kilogram of rice, high methane emissions from paddy cultivation, and nitrate contamination of groundwater associated with serious health risks. To address these challenges, the authors recommend capping state procurement at 40% of production, discontinuing state MSP bonuses, limiting free PDS supplies to the most vulnerable households, shifting ethanol production towards maize, and replacing fertiliser subsidies with direct income support. My 101yo grandmother passed away last night and I am very sad. But she has given me a weird perspective I had not considered any day before today. She was 52 when I was born in 1976. I am going to be 50 next month. She lived an entire life all over again in the time that I have been alive. The coolest thing about my grandmother more than the fact that she was a badass and didn't put up with any bullshit was that she was standing in the front row of the Paramount theater when Frank Sinatra played there. She cut school to go see him. She told me that he smiled at her and that made the inevitable punishment she was going to get from my great-grandfather even better. But my great-grandfather didn't punish her. He simply smiled at her when she told him what she had done and said "I would have done the same thing." 😂 My grandmother wasn't conventional. She didn't smoke like other people her age. She hated to wear dresses and preferred pants instead and that garnered her a lot of weird looks. She made a home out of a very tiny apartment in Brooklyn that felt like a palace and which I ran through as a child with wild abandon. She had been engaged to this guy named Vinny who broke off the engagement and later tried to rekindle their love and she told him to fuck off. That he was only going to break her heart once and to go back to his mother and hang on her apron strings. 😂 When my grandfather (my grandmother had gone on a few dates with him prior to his leaving for war) got back from WWII and heard that she had broke off her engagement with his rival he showed up at her house in his uniform, knocked on the door and asked her to go on a date with him. He literally stepped back onto New York ground and the first thing he did before going to see any of his family or even going to get lunch was go find my grandmother so he could lock her in as his lady love. She told him she had to think about it and to come back later, then slammed the door in his face. So he came back later. The next day and the day after that and each day she thanked him for his visit but closed the door in his face. This went on for several months until some neighbors and family members intervened and invited him to dinner. My grandfather maybe said 20 words his entire life and most of those 20 words were said during that dinner. He was a very quiet man but he loved my grandmother fiercely. And so he told her during that dinner that he wanted to marry her but he had to save up for an engagement ring, but that would take a year. He asked her to be patient and not see anyone else because according to my grandfather who later told me this story over several years because like I said he didn't say a lot of words in one sitting, grandma "was a real looker" and he was afraid she would go out with somebody else. So as he's eating along with family at this dinner and he makes this awkward pre proposal, she gives him a nasty look and says "I'm not waiting a year. If you want to marry me then we'll get married within 3 months." Which was around the time that the Catholic Church took to give a dispensation. Grandpa was so thrilled with what she said that he never considered she didn't actually say yes, she gave him an ultimatum instead which he gladly accepted.😂 And 3 months later they were married. I would always tease her that she was so mean to Grandpa but she told me that she loved him very much but she couldn't show it because he had to go away to war and there was a chance that he would be killed so she had to harden her heart. She said a lot of girls had to do that in that day because a lot of men didn't come home. And she said she was lucky that he did. I could write so much more. Maybe I will later. I'm too sad right now. So many memories. I loved and love her so much. She was an incredible human being and I am so fortunate to have been her second grandchild. Rest in peace Grandma.♥️

The MoU enables exchange of research, scientific & technical materials, pursue collaborative research programs in specific fields of interest and sharing of instrumentation facility.

Last time on Dragon Ball Z: I made a long ass post discussing my Benzodiazepine dependency. Lots of people sent me DMs, or left comments, calling me "brave", or something (is addiction and/or dependency taboo or something?). People also DMd me saying they also have Benzodiazepine dependency but were too scared to try to taper due to how dangerous the drug can be. Behind the scenes I've basically been a test dummy for some people. Let me share with all of you how cool and badass my taper has been > be me > on benzos for 14 years > not supposed to do more than 90 days > everyone like "wtf bro" > decide to do 25% reduction in dosage > people call me crazy > withdrawals start after two days, or something > day two arrives > insanely high anxiety > heart sometimes races > sometimes feel really hot > sometimes legs feel like jelly > sometimes really grumpy > weird withdrawals arent nonstop > comes in waves seemingly randomly > sometimes better, sometimes worse > not too bad, honestly > really, really, really bad insomnia tho > day five > every clams down > shrimple, not too bad > consult with addiction specialist to help insomnia > give me sleeping pills (trazadone) > "go to hospital if you get dangerous erection" > okay? > hold previous 25% cut for a few weeks > decide to aggressively taper again > another 25% cut > total reduction would be 50% > start > day two arrives > feel really sad > doesnt feel like depression > feel "blue", just low energy and kind of mopey > everything in my life great > no reason to be sad > legs sometimes feel like jello > anxiety back > heart race sometimes > heart sometimes beat really hard > mostly really sad The sadness feels like I'm a 14 year old boy in math class whos crush (Susie Bananas, straight A student, champion of the Spelling Bee) recently told you in secret she has a crush on Joseph FastFeet (fastest kid in school), and now you're sad and have to listen to really emo music in your bedroom while your parents make you pancakes for dinner. It's not crippling depression, but you just feel kind of emotional. The weird heart beat thingie is like, you'll be laying in bed and it's like your heart turned the bass up to fuck off level. I'm in bed and it feels like my heart is punching the mattress through my back. It's interesting. Overall the taper hasn't been too bad. India is the world's largest producer and exporter of rice, yet the Food Corporation of India (FCI) is holding rice stocks that are nearly five times the prescribed buffer norm, at a carrying cost of over Rs. 10,712 crores in FY25. In their latest article, Ashok Gulati, Ritika Juneja, and Purvi Thangaraj trace this surplus to three interlinked policy distortions: open-ended MSP procurement, with several states offering bonuses above the MSP; free electricity and heavily subsidised urea. Instead of addressing these underlying distortions, the government's response has been to divert surplus rice to ethanol production, supplying rice to distilleries at Rs. 23/kg despite FCI's economic cost of about Rs. 44/kg on the justification that it is broken and damaged rice. The authors also highlight the environmental costs of the current policy framework, including the use of ~ 4,000 litres of water to produce one kilogram of rice, high methane emissions from paddy cultivation, and nitrate contamination of groundwater associated with serious health risks. To address these challenges, the authors recommend capping state procurement at 40% of production, discontinuing state MSP bonuses, limiting free PDS supplies to the most vulnerable households, shifting ethanol production towards maize, and replacing fertiliser subsidies with direct income support. Early this morning, members of Florida Task Force 1 (#FLTF1) and Florida Task Force 2 (#FLTF2) returned home after supporting the @StateDept humanitarian mission in Venezuela following the devastating earthquakes. There are moments that remind us why we train for years, why we answer the call without hesitation, and why service reaches far beyond the uniform. For the members of FL-TF1 and FL-TF2, this mission meant leaving their own families behind to stand beside families whose lives changed in an instant. To many Venezuelans, both in their homeland and here in South Florida, these responders became a symbol of hope during one of life’s darkest moments. In Venezuela, they searched through devastation, worked shoulder to shoulder with local and international responders, and never lost sight of the people behind every search. They witnessed unimaginable loss, extraordinary resilience, and a community coming together, refusing to give up. Today, they return home to the families who patiently waited for them, carrying stories they will never forget and the privilege of having served when they were needed most. Welcome home, FL-TF1 and FL-TF2. Miami-Dade is proud of you. South Florida is proud of you. Thank you for showing the world what compassion, courage, and service look like. @usembassyve Video

Last December, the FBI announced Operation Red Circus, our ongoing effort to disrupt Russian state-sponsored cyber threats to the United States and our interests abroad. As part of that announcement, the FBI and partners released a joint Cybersecurity Advisory on pro-Russia hacktivist groups conducting opportunistic attacks against critical infrastructure, including the water, agriculture, and energy sectors. A mission priority of Operation Red Circus is targeting and arresting individuals for their roles in hacktivist groups such as Cyber Army of Russia Reborn to mitigate planned, malicious cyber-campaigns. This action is part of Operation Riptide and underscores the FBI’s commitment to working with our international partners to disrupt and hold accountable those engaged in malicious cyber activity. Together, we will continue to impose costs on cybercriminals wherever they operate.

The borderless threat of cyberattacks continues to pose high risk on countries across the globe. To combat these threats, the FBI remains committed to working with international partners, such as the Spanish National Police, in order to deter and impose consequences on malicious cybercriminal groups. @policia Video

For the IT admins & security folks who are unaware... In Windows Server 2025, RPC over named pipes (via SMB) for the Print Spooler is disabled by default. I believe this started with Windows Server 2022 23H2 and up. Also EFS is now similar to WebClient where it can be targeted but has to be activated first. There's a netexec module to perform this one for inquiring minds... It's also common to see DFS on Domain Controllers but of course it's not enabled by default. So tools like Coercer seem to not be too successful against Server 2025 in basic out of the box configurations.

#Delhi is set to introduce #ChildProtectionCommittees in all 5,633 schools across the capital by the end of July, making child safety a permanent part of the education system rather than a temporary campaign. The decision was taken during a meeting chaired by LG #TaranjitSinghSandhu and CM #RekhaGupta at Raj Niwas. The initiative covers Delhi government schools, government-aided schools, MCD, NDMC and Delhi Cantonment Board schools, as well as private schools. The government has also directed that counsellors be made available in every school, with students receiving sessions on safe and unsafe touch, personal boundaries, gender sensitisation and self-defence. Authorities have been asked to implement a comprehensive student safety checklist, operationalise SOPs for handling POCSO cases, and conduct joint school inspections involving parents, education officials, police and school heads. Officials said the objective is to build a long-term child protection system that ensures every child in Delhi studies in a safe and secure environment.

Candidate for the position of United Nations Secretary-General, H.E. Ms. María Fernanda Espinosa, calls on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. Islamabad, 6 July 2026.

Islamabad: 6 July 2026. Candidate for the position of United Nations Secretary-General, H.E. Ms. María Fernanda Espinosa, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House today. While welcoming Ms. Espinosa, the Prime Minister expressed Pakistan’s longstanding commitment to multilateralism, as well as the high significance it has always attached to the United Nations. While reaffirming this abiding commitment to the UN, the Prime Minister expressed the hope that the incoming leadership of the United Nations will continue to work towards promoting the three pillars of the United Nations in a balanced manner through adherence to the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, faithful implementation of UN Security Council resolutions, respect for international law and treaties, and active international cooperation among Member States within the framework of the UN Charter to promote global peace and prosperity. Ms. Espinosa thanked the Prime Minister for receiving her and praised Pakistan for its leading role in recent regional peace efforts as well as its active participation in the United Nations over the past many decades. Ms.Espinosa had previously visited Pakistan in 2019 in her capacity as President of the United Nations General Assembly. Video

Et voici ce qui semble être une photo du tir chinois de ce matin. Pour rappel il est très difficile, voire impossible, de différencier un JL-2 d'un JL-3 sur une photo, puisque le "JL-3" présenté le 3 septembre dernier lors du défilé des 80 ans de la victoire sur le Japon était en fait la maquette d'un JL-2 sur laquelle le nom avait été effacé pour être remplacé par JL-3. Pour ce test c'est probablement la portée qui donne l'indice le plus probant, le JL-3 étant crédité d'une portée plus longue, de l'ordre de 10 000 km. On notera que ni la Corée du Sud, ni le Japon ne se sont offusqués d'un survol de leur territoire durant ce test, ce qui aurait dû être le cas en cas de tir depuis la Mer de Bohai, ce qui tend à privilégier l'hypothèse d'un tir depuis la Mer de Chine Méridionale, au large de Hong Kong et Macao. Etienne Marcuz (@Etienne_Marcuz) 🇨🇳🚀 Tir de missile depuis un SNLE chinois ☢️🇨🇳 La Chine a procédé tôt ce matin (06h01 heure de Paris) à un tir inédit de missile balistique depuis l'un de ses sous-marins nucléaires lanceurs d'engins (SLBM tiré par un SNLE). Si Pékin tire régulièrement ce type de missile d'Est en Ouest pour que la charge retombe sur son propre territoire, l'événement de ce matin se démarque par une retombée dans le Pacifique, à plus de 7200 km de distance du point de tir. C'est notable pour deux raisons: - ce type de trajectoire permet de tester l'engin à portée maximale, alors que les tests habituels utilisent des trajectoires en cloche (~3000 km). Les contraintes thermiques et mécaniques sont différentes. Il s'agissait d'ailleurs du premier tir SLBM chinois à portée maximale. - cela permet aux compétiteurs stratégiques, et notamment aux Etats-Unis, d'évaluer les performances du système d'armes, notamment en termes de comportement lors de la rentrée atmosphérique et de précision. L'USAF avait d'ailleurs déployé l'un de ses rares avions de télémesure COBRA BALL sur la zone. Ce test est donc avant tout une démonstration de crédibilité de la dissuasion chinoise à l'heure du retour de la compétition entre grandes puissances. Rappelons que les SNLE servent à la frappe en second et doivent donc garantir à tout adversaire la capacité de la Chine à répondre de manière massive à une attaque, même surprise, menaçant ses intérêts vitaux. Notons que la Chine a fait preuve de responsabilité en notifiant en amont les pays de la région la tenue de ce test, ainsi qu'en déposant des restrictions à la navigation aérienne et maritime. Toutefois, ces restrictions pointent justement vers une possible anomalie. En effet, la Chine a revendiqué le tir d'un SLBM. Or, les restrictions indiquaient que deux tirs devaient avoir lieu, l'un depuis la Mer de Bohai et l'autre depuis la Mer de Chine Méridionale, soit les deux bastions des SNLE chinois. Il est donc possible que l'un des deux SNLE ait connu un dysfonctionnement, l'empêchant de tirer son missile. Toutefois, plusieurs créneaux étaient prévus pour ce test, courant jusqu'au 8 juillet. Patientons donc jusque là... 📸 SLBM chinois JL-2 durant un défilé militaire, modèle qui a probablement été tiré ce matin. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Etienne_Marcuz/status/2074050194564420051#m

My husband and I are honored and thrilled to participate in the Invest America program and gift a share of our SpaceX stock to a Trump Account for each of more than two million children across our great nation. Every American child under 18 can benefit from having a Trump Account, but our gift specifically goes to the Accounts of children (ages 11-17) that live in areas with lower average household incomes with a bit more emphasis for those that live near our central Texas home. We have been fortunate in our careers and hope this gift encourages the next generation to continue the journey of enabling humanity to live and fly amongst the stars. A huge thanks to all that worked to bring this incredible program to life. Brad Gerstner (@altcap) Dear America, Starting today, on the 250th birthday of our country, millions of children will now benefit from a new & powerful American birthright - a privately owned investment account from birth. Every child a shareholder in the great American economy! American capitalism is the greatest prosperity-creating engine the world has ever known. It has unlocked unprecedented abundance for our country and untold life-advancing innovation. From clean food & water to cars & planes to vaccines & cures to computers & phones. Through depressions & world wars, through panics & pandemics, betting on America has been the best investment in human history. But far too many hardworking families feel like they are on the outside looking in - like the American Dream has become out of reach. The Invest America Act changes all that. Signed into law by President Trump it establishes the Trump Accounts - launching today - making every child a shareholder from birth. Every account seeded with $1000 in America's best companies - making every child a direct participant in our stock markets & American capitalism. But it doesn’t stop there. Representing the best of our civic traditions, an unprecedented outpouring of additional private contributions into these accounts is already underway. Billions of dollars have been committed by philanthropists & corporations to tens of millions of children across the country. A new form of massive, direct philanthropy & corporate benefits directly to America’s kids is just getting started. From adopting all the kids of a school or organization to a city or state. America is the most giving country in the history of the world - and Trump Accounts provide a new open source platform to enable anybody to contribute to anybody. Trillions of dollars will compound in these accounts over the next 20 years. But this is about more than just figures on an account statement. By investing in the next generation, our country is providing tangible opportunities to all future generations of Americans: an education, a first home, the ability to start a business, and the foundation for a lifetime of savings. Trump Accounts provide hope to those feeling hopeless - unlocking unlimited human potential. Trump Accounts do this through a massive public - private partnership that empower the individual not the state. They double down on free market capitalist democracy by empowering the individual rather than growing dependency on government. Aligning citizens with capitalism rather than pitting them against it. Perhaps of equal importance, let us not lose sight of the fact that this is a movement that unites our country. Despite the many issues that divide us, this one big idea brings everyone together. From the most conservative to the most progressive leaders, we have found people of goodwill willing to step up and do the right thing to help the next generation. Trump Accounts represent the very best of our democracy and the American promise issued two hundred and fifty years ago today. I am grateful to all those who have partnered with us to get this far and we dedicate our tireless efforts to make certain that the Invest America Act achieves its maximum potential. Let us advance into the future with a renewed sense of confidence, optimism and restored faith in the American Dream for EVERY American. Happy 250th Birthday, America! Warm felicitations to President Donald J. Trump and the people of the United States on the historic occasion of the 250th Anniversary of American Independence. Pakistan joins the United States in celebrating this remarkable milestone and the enduring values of freedom, resilience, and democracy. NIOT Expresses Gratitude to the Indian Coast Guard for Swift Recovery of ANMS Buoy NIOT-MOES expresses its sincere gratitude to the Indian Coast Guard, and the Captain and crew of ICGS Rani Gaidinliu, for their swift response and exemplary support in recovering NIOT's indigenously developed Ambient Noise Measurement System (ANMS) Buoy, which had drifted more than 150 km away from its deployed location off the Nellore coast following suspected vandalism that also caused damage to the buoy. The ANMS Buoy is a vital ocean observation system that continuously monitors the underwater acoustic environment, generating valuable data for oceanographic research, coastal ecosystem studies, and rainfall studies. Owing to the prompt action and seamless coordination of the Indian Coast Guard, the buoy was successfully recovered and safely handed over to NIOT's hired boat off Nizampatnam Port. This timely assistance reflects the Indian Coast Guard's unwavering commitment to safeguarding India's valuable marine scientific assets and supporting ocean research.

🚨Javier Aguirre on Jude Bellingham: 🗣️ Reporter: “What made Jude Bellingham so difficult for your team to deal with tonight?” 🗣️ Javier Aguirre: “It’s not just his quality. We prepared for his quality. What makes him so difficult is that he never stays in one place. One minute he’s helping in midfield, the next he’s arriving in the box like a centre-forward. You think you’ve picked him up, then he disappears from your line of sight for one second… and that’s enough. For his first goal, we had defenders in the right positions. But Jude attacked the space with perfect timing. For the second goal, exactly the same story. He reads the game half a second quicker than everybody else. Players like that punish the smallest mistake. You can spend the whole week analysing them, showing videos, working on defensive shape… but if you lose concentration for one moment, he’s there. Tonight, that’s exactly what happened. We didn’t lose because we didn’t respect Jude Bellingham. We lost because, for two moments, we couldn’t stop him from doing what world-class players do.

All eyes on Earth 👀 Airbus is making a further contribution to the world’s largest environmental programme, Europe’s @CopernicusEU. 🌍 We just completed testing of the second Copernicus Sentinel-4 air quality monitoring optical instrument, which will continuously monitor the atmosphere above Europe to track pollutants and gases. Why does this matter? Understanding what is in our atmosphere helps us better manage the risks of natural threats like desert dust, volcanic ash, and even pollen. 🔎 This data will enable scientists, environmental agencies and policymakers to study the composition of the air that European citizens breathe, and adapt European public health policies. What matters in Space matters on Earth, and Earth observation satellites are a vital tool to monitor the effects of climate change on natural ecosystems. In fact more than 50% of climate variables can only be measured from Space. That is what the Copernicus programme is all about: providing the insights we need to understand climate and guide efforts on the ground to face environmental challenges.🌿 The Copernicus programme is a joint initiative between the European Union (EU) and the European Space Agency (@ESA).

اسلام آباد: 6 جولائی 2026. وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیرِ صدارت نوجوانوں کو روزگار مہیا کرنے کے حوالے سے جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ بیرون ملک پاکستانی سفارتخانے پاکستانی افرادی قوت کیلئے روزگار کے مواقع کی تلاش میں تیزی لے کر آئیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایات کیں کہ پروٹیکٹریٹ آف امیگریشن کے تمام تر نظام کو ڈیجیٹائیز کیا جائے اور افرادی قوت بالخصوص نوجوانوں کو وزارت برائے سمندر پار مقیم پاکستانی، نیووٹیک اور یوتھ پروگرام ہنر اور مختلف زبانوں کے کورسس بمعہ سرٹیفیکیشنز یقینی بنائیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ پاکستان کی افرادی قوت با صلاحیت ہے، بین الاقوامی معیار کی تعلیم و عالمی سطح پر رسائی کیلئے ہر ممکن اقدام اٹھا رہے ہیں. پاکستانی سفارتخانے بیرون ملک میسر روزگار کے مواقع سے آگاہی اور ڈیٹا کی فراہمی کیلئے اقدامات تیز کریں. پاکستانی سرٹیفیکیشنز کو بین الاقوامی معیار سے ہم آہنگ کرنے کیلئے تمام ادارے مختلف ممالک سے روابط مضبوط کرے. جن ممالک میں پاکستانی ہنرمند افراد کیلئے روزگار کے مواقع میسر ہیں، انکی زبان کی تعلیم بمعہ سرٹیفیکیشنز یقینی بنائی جائے. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ نیووٹیک (NAVTTC) کے تحت تکنیکی و فنی تربیت کے اداروں کی کارکردگی اور کنٹری آف ڈیسٹینیشن سینٹرز کے قیام پر بھی رپورٹ پیش کی جائے. اجلاس کو افرادی قوت بالخصوص نوجوانوں کیلئے روزگار کے مواقع پر تفصیلی بریفنگ دی گئی. بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ ڈیجیٹل یوتھ ہب میں 8 لاکھ نوجوان رجسٹر ہو چکے ہیں. بیرون ملک تعمیرات، زراعت، سیاحت، صحت، ٹرانسپورٹ، بائیوٹیکنالوجی، مینیوفیکچرنگ، شپ بلنڈنگ، انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی، انجینئرنگ، نرسنگ، دواسازی اور اشیاء خورونوش کی تیاری کے شعبوں میں روزگار کے مواقع موجود ہیں. ان شعبوں میں پاکستانیوں کو روزگار فراہم کرنے کیلئے تربیتی پروگرام جاری ہیں. پاکستانی سفارتخانے مختلف ممالک میں میسر روزگار کے مواقع اور ان کیلئے درکار قابلیت ڈیجیٹل یوتھ ہب پورٹل پر فراہم کریں گے. اجلاس میں نائب وزیرِ اعظم و وزیرِ خارجہ سینیٹر محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزراء ڈاکٹر مصدق ملک، عطاء اللہ تارڑ، چوہدری سالک حسین، وزیرِ مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی، چیئرمین نیوٹیک راجا قمر الاسلام، چیئرمین وزیرِ اعظم یوتھ پروگرام رانا مشہود احمد خان اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی. मुख्यमंत्री श्रीमती रेखा गुप्ता ने माननीय उपराज्यपाल श्री तरनजीत सिंह संधू के साथ बैठक कर ‘बाल संरक्षण माह’ के अंतर्गत चल रहे व्यापक POCSO जागरूकता अभियान एवं बच्चों की सुरक्षा से जुड़े कार्यों की समीक्षा की। जुलाई के अंत तक दिल्ली के सभी 5,633 विद्यालयों में POCSO के अनुरूप बाल संरक्षण समितियों का गठन सुनिश्चित किया जाएगा। साथ ही विद्यालयों, आंगनवाड़ी-सह-पालना घरों, बाल देखभाल संस्थानों और जिला बाल संरक्षण इकाइयों के माध्यम से प्रशिक्षण, जनजागरूकता, साइबर सुरक्षा, आत्मरक्षा तथा POCSO जागरूकता अभियान को और सशक्त किया जाएगा। शिक्षा विभाग, महिला एवं बाल विकास विभाग तथा दिल्ली पुलिस के संयुक्त दल नियमित निरीक्षण के माध्यम से सुरक्षा व्यवस्थाओं की निगरानी करेंगे। दिल्ली सरकार बच्चों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने और उनके लिए सुरक्षित वातावरण के निर्माण के लिए पूर्णतः प्रतिबद्ध है। @SandhuTaranjitS

India is the world's largest producer and exporter of rice, yet the Food Corporation of India (FCI) is holding rice stocks that are nearly five times the prescribed buffer norm, at a carrying cost of over Rs. 10,712 crores in FY25. In their latest article, Ashok Gulati, Ritika Juneja, and Purvi Thangaraj trace this surplus to three interlinked policy distortions: open-ended MSP procurement, with several states offering bonuses above the MSP; free electricity and heavily subsidised urea. Instead of addressing these underlying distortions, the government's response has been to divert surplus rice to ethanol production, supplying rice to distilleries at Rs. 23/kg despite FCI's economic cost of about Rs. 44/kg on the justification that it is broken and damaged rice. The authors also highlight the environmental costs of the current policy framework, including the use of ~ 4,000 litres of water to produce one kilogram of rice, high methane emissions from paddy cultivation, and nitrate contamination of groundwater associated with serious health risks. To address these challenges, the authors recommend capping state procurement at 40% of production, discontinuing state MSP bonuses, limiting free PDS supplies to the most vulnerable households, shifting ethanol production towards maize, and replacing fertiliser subsidies with direct income support. Assented the Central Bank of Kenya (Amendment) Bill, 2026, ushering in sweeping reforms aimed at strengthening the CBK’s capacity to safeguard financial stability, improve banking oversight, and modernise the country’s monetary policy framework. The new law introduces a distinct legal framework separating the Central Bank’s routine monetary policy operations from Emergency Liquidity Assistance (ELA). The move will improve Kenya’s preparedness to respond to financial crises while protecting taxpayers and the banking sector. Under the amendment, ELA can only be extended to banks that meet strict conditions on solvency, viability, and systemic risk. The provision aims to separate ordinary liquidity management from extraordinary interventions during periods of financial distress. One of the key reforms elevates financial system stability and sound banking regulation as secondary objectives of the Central Bank, while retaining price stability as its primary mandate. The law formally recognises the CBK’s role in promoting the integrity, resilience, and proper functioning of Kenya’s financial system. Additionally, to enhance governance, nominees for Deputy Governor positions will now be vetted and approved by the National Assembly before appointment. The provision aligns their process with that of the Governor and reinforces parliamentary oversight of senior leadership at the monetary authority. The amendment also gives statutory backing to the CBK’s training mandate through the Central Bank of Kenya Institute of Monetary Studies. It also provides a legal framework for collaboration with national, regional, and international institutions to enhance knowledge sharing and cross-border cooperation. The law further updates various provisions by replacing references to the defunct Deposit Protection Fund Board with the Kenya Deposit Insurance Corporation, bringing the Act in line with the current deposit protection framework. It also expands legal clarity on CBK’s authority to deal in gold and other precious metals as part of reserve management. This will support growth of Kenya’s mining sector and aligns Kenya with practices in Tanzania, Ghana, and South Africa. Also signed into law the Parliamentary Pensions (Amendment) Bill, 2023, bringing in reforms that align the parliamentary pension framework with the Constitution and extend benefits to both Members of the National Assembly and the Senate. The legislation updates the Parliamentary Pensions Act of 1983, which became outdated after the promulgation of the 2010 Constitution established a bicameral Parliament. The new law formally recognises both the National Assembly and the Senate in the administration of parliamentary pensions and ensures senators are entitled to benefits under the same framework as MPs. Among the major reforms, the law redefines “child” to mean a person below 18 years, up from 16 years, to conform with the Constitution. The Act further reconstitutes the Parliamentary Pensions Management Committee and the Appeals Committee to include representation from both Houses, reflecting Kenya’s bicameral structure. To preserve public service pension policy, the amended law retains gratuity payments only for legislators who serve less than five years.

Advancing through the China Nala Axis, they overcame fierce enemy resistance in a meticulously coordinated operation, capturing Bump-II, Bump-III and Kalapathar by 07 Jul 1999. During the battle, the Gunners of 4 Field Regiment, 15 Field Regiment, 141 Field Regiment, 255 Field Regiment and 212 Rocket Regiment delivered relentless and accurate fire, devastating enemy defences across the Jubar heights and paving the way for the Infantry assault. The capture of these dominating features shattered the enemy's defensive posture, with Bump-III serving as the Firm Base for the subsequent assaults on Tharu, Kukarthang and Bump-I. The operation remains a shining example of exceptional courage, meticulous planning and seamless Infantry-Artillery coordination during Operation VIJAY.
